public_gates: M817 may train only a separate residual calibrator
M817 must not update actor or M761 residual-head parameters
M817 must create and respect source-heldout split before optimization
M817 must run train and holdout exact gates
M817 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train M761 residual-head parameters
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not widen the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not train on holdout rows
do not tune from private holdout failures
do not claim true wheel-level faults from current proxy data

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: source-heldout adaptive primary residual calibration implementation
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether a separate residual calibrator can preserve M814 primary rows and intervention sensitivity under source-heldout exact gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: calibrator probe only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if actor or residual-head checksum changes
stop if holdout normal rows regress
stop if old replay or behavior gates regress
fallback_plan: if split is invalid, design a larger adaptive corpus wave
if holdout regresses, audit objective overfit before another calibrator
if intervention sensitivity collapses, return to objective design
if old gates regress, require retention repair design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M817 implements the design from M816

hypothesis: A small separate residual calibrator can preserve M814 primary normal rows and intervention sensitivity on a source-heldout split without changing actor or residual-head weights.
success_criteria: M817 writes split training evaluation calibrator summary and documentation artifacts
M817 confirms actor and M761 residual-head checksums unchanged
M817 reports train and holdout normal/intervention exact metrics
M817 reports old replay or behavior retention metrics
M817 classifies the result without promoting a checkpoint
failure_criteria: implementation weakens the primary margin threshold

commands.name: calibration_probe
commands.command: implement and run source-heldout residual calibration probe; expected run dir runs/m817_v4_adaptive_primary_residual_calibration

decision_rule: M817 may produce only a calibrator probe candidate or a classified negative result. It must not run PPO or promote.
